rows.text: The new consolidated seven-year total capital expenditures of $40.0 billion are expected to support 9%-10% consolidated investment base growth from 2027-2033 and an expected consolidated non-GAAP adjusted EPS compound annual growth rate (CAGR) of 10%-11% for 2027-2033.

NiSource is reaffirming its 2026 non‑GAAP consolidated adjusted EPS guidance of $2.02-$2.07 and its compound annual growth rate (CAGR) with respect to non-GAAP consolidated adjusted EPS of 9%-10% from 2026-2033.
